name: Oasys Water
description: Forward-osmosis desalination and brine-concentration developer, originally of Cambridge, Massachusetts. No longer independent: its forward-osmosis patent ownership, equipment assets, brand and trademarks were bought by CAMCE Water (US), closing 3 April 2018.
notes: oasyswater.com no longer serves the company: the TLS certificate expired 15 Nov 2024 and the domain now serves an unrelated home-appliance blog. Operations were suspended and assets sold in 2017-2018; the CAMCE annual report records the IP and brand transfer, and the brand was renamed Oasys Holding Inc. / Oasys Water LLC under CAMCE. Treat as a historical supplier, not a live one.
